e.v: Sets how long pings remain visible for you. In Continuous mode, approaching a ping temporarily hides its world marker, which reappears after you move away. This is a local player setting and is not synchronized with the server.
Sets the maximum number of active pings per player. When the limit is reached, the oldest ping is replaced. Only the host can change this setting; it is stored with the current savegame.
Sets whether pings are visible only to players on the same farm or to players on every farm. Only the host can change this setting; it is stored with the current savegame.
